{{Top}} {{Update|[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]}} {{Character |type=Criminal |image=[[File:VectNokru-SWCT.png]] |name=Vect Nokru |homeworld=[[Alderaan]]{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars|cardname=Vect Nokru|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/370777/cid/22170396/2023-Topps-Star-Wars-66-Vect-Nokru}} |birth= |death=[[9 BBY]], [[Daiyu]]{{KenobiDate|II|Vect Nokru's [[death]] on [[Daiyu]]}} |species=[[Human]] {{C|[[Alderaanian]]}} |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Gray]]{{Kenobi|Part I}} |feathers= |eyes=Blue |skin=Light |cyber=[[Cybernetics|Head implants]] |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Black Mask]]''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|I didn't know that Jedi could bleed.|Vect Nokru, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|{{Kenobi|Part II}}}} '''Vect Nokru''' was a [[human]] [[mercenary]] from the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]] who was active during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[9 BBY]], he and his [[Black Mask]] gang were hired by the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] [[Jedi]]-[[hunting]] group the [[Inquisitorius]] to [[Ambush on Alderaan|kidnap]] the ten [[Standard year|year-old]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] of the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]] and use her as bait for the fugitive [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The trio captured the girl on Alderaan and took her to a [[The Den|spice den]] on the planet [[Daiyu]]. Nokru and his assailants locked Leia away and set a [[Hunt for Obi-Wan|trap]] for Kenobi with a decoy. The Jedi [[Search for Princess Leia|fell for]] the bait and was held at gunpoint by the mercenaries, Nokru taunting his new captive. However, Kenobi used a vial of [[spice]] to intoxicate the trio and escape, rescuing Leia in the process. The Third Sister reached Nokru to find her target had escaped and eventually used the mercenary to send a [[bounty]] on the Jedi across the [[Daiyu City|city]] on Daiyu. [[The Grand Inquisitor]], who had arrived to intervene with the Third Sister's unsanctioned actions, then apprehended Nokru. Interrogating the mercenary the Inquisitor demanded Kenobi's location before [[Death|killing]] the mercenary with his [[The Grand Inquisitor's lightsaber|lightsaber]]. ==Biography== ===The kidnapping=== {{Quote|You sure he's gonna come?''"
"''He fought beside her father during the war. He'll come. He won't be able to help it. The Jedi will hunt himself.|Nokru and the Third Sister|}} [[File:VectNokru-OWKpI.png|thumb|right|250px|Vect Nokru returned to his homeworld of Alderaan for a job that entailed kidnapping its heir.]] Vect Nokru was a [[human]] who [[Homeworld|hailed]] from the peaceful [[planet]]{{Film|IV}} [[Alderaan]] but took up the life of a [[mercenary]] criminal. Active during the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], he worked with fellow mercenaries [[Vidara Jurness]] and [[Ayo Bons]] as part of the [[Black Mask]] gang, which operated out of [[Daiyu City]] on the planet [[Daiyu]]. The trio were hired by the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]], a member of the Imperial [[Jedi]]-[[hunting]] group known as the [[Inquisitorius]], in [[9 BBY]]. Their job was to [[Ambush on Alderaan|kidnap]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], the ten [[Standard year|year-old]] daughter of [[Alderaanian monarchy|Queen]] [[Breha Organa]] and [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] of''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'' Nokru's homeworld of Alderaan. The purpose of the kidnapping was to [[Hunt for Obi-Wan|draw out]] the fugitive Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from hiding, the Third Sister understanding that Kenobi had fought alongside Bail before the [[Great Jedi Purge|fall]] of the [[Jedi Order]] ten years before. The mercenary trio traveled to the grounds of the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan]] and Nokru observed the [[Youngling|young]] Leia get brought into the palace by her mother and two [[Alderaan Guard]]s after the girl had run off to watch [[starship]]s take off. Nokru and his accomplices waited by the [[tree]] in the woods where Leia frequented until the ten-year old returned after running out of the palace again. The mercenaries greeted his target, who wondered why the man was there. As Nokru's two assailants crept behind the girl, he revealed he was there for her, and Leia, finding herself surrounded, began running from them. Nokru signaled the other two to make chase, and the two other mercenaries pursued Leia through the woods. The pair were unable to catch the girl, who found an Alderaan guard who was searching for her. Nokru then intervened and shot the guard with his [[blaster pistol]], and his accomplices surrounded and captured Leia. [[File:KidnappingOfLeiaOrgana-OWKpI.png|thumb|left|300px|Nokru and his cohorts surround Leia.]] The mercenaries brought Leia aboard their ship and departed for the planet{{Kenobi|Part II}} Daiyu, hiding their vessel's signature behind a [[freighter]]. Nokru had the alien mercenary tie her to a chair in a cell and lock her away. As the starship approached Daiyu, Nokru went to check on his captive, finding her using her [[toy droid]] [[L0-LA59|Lola]] to try and escape. Leia proclaimed that she was not afraid the mercenary, who told her to "give it time" and smashed Lola on the ground. The girl threatened that Bail Organa would send an army to save her, but Nokru told her no one was coming and left her alone in the cell again. He also contacted the Third Sister, questioning whether Kenobi would come for Leia. The Inquisitor assured him the plan would work, adding that the Jedi would not be able to help it. ===Capturing Kenobi=== {{Quote|The Inquisitor really figured you out. She'll be here soon. Then we'll be rich and you'll be dead.|Nokru taunts Kenobi|}} [[File:NokruKenobi-OWKpII.png|thumb|300px|Nokru taunts Kenobi for how easily he was captured.]] Meanwhile Bail had been able to find the signature of Nokru's ship and track it to Daiyu and convinced Kenobi to leave his hiding place on the planet [[Tatooine]] to help rescue Leia. Nokru brought Leia to [[The Den]], a spice den in Daiyu's [[Daiyu City|city]], and locked her in a cell, leaving a derelict [[droid]] under a cloak as a decoy in another as a trap. [[Search for Princess Leia|Arriving]] on Daiyu himself, Kenobi was able to located the decoy cell and found the fake Leia. With the Jedi in their trap, Nokru's two companions held Kenobi at gunpoint before Nokru himself entered the room. The mercenary stated how surprised he was that the Jedi had fell for it and added that he thought his new captive would be smarter, punching Kenobi in the gut. The green-skinned mercenary handed Nokru [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber|Kenobi's lightsaber]], and he gloated that the Third Sister had figured the Jedi out and would arrive soon, making the mercenaries rich. Kenobi only questioned where Leia was, Nokru insisting that it did not matter. The mercenary claimed his captive was no longer a Jedi and added that Kenobi was bleeding all over the floor. In a witty response, Kenobi revealed a vial of [[Color|red]] [[spice]] and smashed it on the floor, putting his [[breath mask]] on as a spice cloud went everywhere. Nokru covered his face when the Jedi grabbed back his [[lightsaber]] and kicked the mercenary, leaving the room with the door shut where he managed to find and rescue Leia. ===The Inquisitors arrive=== {{Quote|Send it across the city. I want every lowlife and bounty hunter on this planet to know Kenobi is here. They only report to me.''"
"''You really think those scum can catch a Jedi?''"
"''I don't want them to catch him. I want them to squeeze him. He'll reveal himself eventually, and I will be waiting.|The Third Sister and Nokru|}} [[File:Bisect-Vect.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Vect Nokru was killed by the Grand Inquisitor.]] Nokru and his accomplices were intoxicated by the spice cloud and lay on the floor in a drugged state. The mercenary leaned on the door until the Third Sister arrived, demanding to know where Kenobi was. The Inquisitor left and was met by three other Inquisitors—[[the Grand Inquisitor]], [[Fourth Sister]], and [[Fifth Brother]]—who had learned of her unsanctioned mission to capture Kenobi. After the [[Grand Inquisitor]] told her to stand down, the Third Sister disobeyed her superior's orders and contacted Nokru, who had recovered from the spice. The Third Sister ordered him to send out a [[bounty]] on Kenobi under the Inquisitor out to every [[bounty hunter]] in the [[city]]. The mercenary was skeptical on whether the hunters would be able to catch a Jedi, but the Third Sister specified that she only wanted the "low-lifes" to squeeze her target until he revealed himself. Nokru complied and sent the bounty out, catching the attention of all the bounty hunters, who began there search for Kenobi. However, the Grand Inquisitor also learned of the bounty and apprehended the mercenary, interrogating him on the street. Pulling Nokru towards his [[The Grand Inquisitor's lightsaber|double-bladed spinning lightsaber]] with [[the Force]], the Grand Inquisitor demanded to know where Kenobi was. The mercenary stressed that he did not know, only to be caught by the spinning lightsaber and killed. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I didn't know that Jedi could bleed. I'm surprised you fell for it. I figured you'd be smarter than to risk everything for a spoiled little brat.|Nokru taunts Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} [[File:VectNokru-Villains2024.png|thumb|right|250px|The criminal Vect Nokru]] Vect Nokru was a [[human]] with light skin, blue [[eye]]s and gray, balding [[hair]]. Taking up a life of crime despite hailing from the notably peaceful Alderaan, Nokru was a mercenary who was willing to kidnap even children for a job. Even Leia Organa's status as the princess of Nokru's homeworld did not stop the [[Alderaanian]] criminal. In fact, he wrote off the young princess as a spoiled brat. He frequently taunted his captives, insisting that they would not be able to escape and how they were doomed. Nokru had his doubts that Kenobi was intelligent enough to take his bait in the form of Leia Organa, but was surprised to see that the plan had worked. He was further skeptical that any bounty hunter would be able to capture a Jedi. The mercenary panicked as he was interrogated by the Grand Inquisitor at the Inquisitor's [[Double-bladed spinning lightsaber|lightsaber blade]] iterating his answers more slowly as death close in on him. ==Equipment== Nokru wore a shirt colored in yellow, orange and Black in a pattern and green trousers. He also donned a black [[jacket]] and brown [[boot]]s and used a [[blaster]] [[pistol]]. The mercenary had a pair of [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] implants in the back of his head. ==Behind the scenes== Vect Nokru first appeared in "[[Part I]]" of the [[Disney+]] live-action television series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']], directed by [[Deborah Chow]] and released on [[May 27]], [[2022]].{{SW|url=news/obi-wan-kenobi-may-27|text=''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' to Premiere May 27 with Two Episodes}} Portrayed by [[Flea (actor)|Flea]], the bassist in the band [[Wikipedia:Red Hot Chili Peppers|Red Hot Chili Peppers]], his first name was revealed in the subtitles of the episode, while his last name was revealed by the subtitles of the following episode, "[[Part II]]," directed again by Chow and premiered alongside "Part I" on the same day. Prior to the premiere of the two episodes, footage of Nokru was featured in the teaser trailer for ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'', published on YouTube on [[March 9]] of that year.{{SWYouTube|TWTfhyvzTx0|Obi-Wan
